menu:3108220:1.text: What are you planning to buy?

say:1:1122544001:1.text: One of the store owners has a job for us. He had an appointment with a merchant to meet at the Thundra Clan today to negotiate a price for his goods, but something came up and he couldn't make it, so he wanted someone else to go in his place.
say:1:1122544001:1.source_cn: 杂货店老板发了份委托。他和一个商人约好今天到雷矛聚落见...

say:2:1122544002:1.text: According to him, the current buyer's bid is 280 gold, but he needs to sell at 320. That's the lowest he can go.
say:2:1122544002:1.source_cn: 按他说的，目前买家开价是二百八十金币，但他的底价是三百...

say:3:1122544003:1.text: Of course, if you can negotiate a higher selling price, that's even better.
say:3:1122544003:1.source_cn: 当然，如果你能把价格谈得更高，那自然更好。

say:4:1122544004:1.text: None of us ruffians are qualified to do this type of job, but you might be able to pull it off.
say:4:1122544004:1.source_cn: 其他人都做不来这种事。不如你去试试？
say:4:1122544004:1.male: None of us ruffians are qualified to do this type of job, but you might be able to pull it off.
say:4:1122544004:1.female: None of us ruffians are qualified to do this type of job, but you might be able to pull it off.

say:5:1122544005:0.text: Their secret signal is to greet each other with a <style="highlight">wave</style>. When the price is agreed upon, just bring the merchant's purchase order to the store owner.
say:5:1122544005:0.source_cn: 他们的接头暗号是做一个招手<style=highlig...

say:0:1122544501:0.text: I wonder which one is the merchant we're looking for. Let's wave<sprite name=spui_behaviour_icon_solo_001> and see who says hello.
say:0:1122544501:0.source_cn: 不知道哪一位才是来交易的商人……我们招手<sprite...

say:1:1122545001:1.text: You're the seller, right? You're late.
say:1:1122545001:1.source_cn: 呵，你就是那批货的卖家？真是姗姗来迟啊。
say:1:1122545001:1.male: You're the seller, right? You're late.
say:1:1122545001:1.female: You're the seller, right? You're late.

say:2:1122545002:1.text: You already know my asking price, 280 gold. If that's good for you, it's a done deal.
say:2:1122545002:1.source_cn: 你知道我的开价，要是能接受的话……交易愉快？
say:2:1122545002:1.male: You already know my asking price, 280 gold. If that's good for you, it's a done deal.
say:2:1122545002:1.female: You already know my asking price, 280 gold. If that's good for you, it's a done deal.

choice_prompt:3:1122545002.text: You already know my asking price, 280 gold. If that's good for you, it's a done deal.
choice_prompt:3:1122545002.source_cn: 你知道我的开价，要是能接受的话……交易愉快？
choice_prompt:3:1122545002.male: You already know my asking price, 280 gold. If that's good for you, it's a done deal.
choice_prompt:3:1122545002.female: You already know my asking price, 280 gold. If that's good for you, it's a done deal.

say:4:1122545004:1.text: You're not going to talk your way into getting that price.
say:4:1122545004:1.source_cn: 你想拿到这个价，可不能光凭一张嘴。
say:4:1122545004:1.male: You're not going to talk your way into getting that price.
say:4:1122545004:1.female: You're not going to talk your way into getting that price.

say:5:1122545005:1.text: We play a round of Century Quest. You beat me, and I'll pay whatever you want. If I win, then I set the price.
say:5:1122545005:1.source_cn: 来一局百物牌如何？只要你反应快过我，我就在价格上让你一步。
say:5:1122545005:1.male: We play a round of Century Quest. You beat me, and I'll pay whatever you want. If I win, then I set the price.
say:5:1122545005:1.female: We play a round of Century Quest. You beat me, and I'll pay whatever you want. If I win, then I set the price.

choice:3:0:1.text: The lowest I can go is 320!
choice:3:0:1.male: The lowest I can go is 320!
choice:3:0:1.female: The lowest I can go is 320!

choice:3:1:2.text: The lowest I can go is 350!
choice:3:1:2.male: The lowest I can go is 350!
choice:3:1:2.female: The lowest I can go is 350!

say:7:1122545003:1.text: It's not fun doing business like this. I'll give you a good deal. I can go as high as 330 gold but...
say:7:1122545003:1.source_cn: 你这样做生意就没意思了。三百三十金币，这是我能接受的最...
say:7:1122545003:1.male: It's not fun doing business like this. I'll give you a good deal. I can go as high as 330 gold but...
say:7:1122545003:1.female: It's not fun doing business like this. I'll give you a good deal. I can go as high as 330 gold but...

choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 低于三百八十金币免谈！

say:0:1122546001:0.text: I guess you won. We'll go with the price you said earlier.
say:0:1122546001:0.source_cn: 好吧……是你更胜一筹，就按你说的价来。
say:0:1122546001:0.male: I guess you won. We'll go with the price you said earlier.
say:0:1122546001:0.female: I guess you won. We'll go with the price you said earlier.

say:1:1122546002:0.text: I'm not too happy about this, but a deal is a deal. The purchase order is in my bag. Find it yourself.
say:1:1122546002:0.source_cn: 不过我不是很高兴。进货单就在我的包里，麻烦你自己找一下吧。
say:1:1122546002:0.male: I'm not too happy about this, but a deal is a deal. The purchase order is in my bag. Find it yourself.
say:1:1122546002:0.female: I'm not too happy about this, but a deal is a deal. The purchase order is in my bag. Find it yourself.

say:0:1122547001:0.text: Magister, let's take the purchase order to the store owner!
say:0:1122547001:0.source_cn: 主人，我们得把进货单拿给杂货店的老板才行！
say:0:1122547001:0.male: Magister, let's take the purchase order to the store owner!
say:0:1122547001:0.female: Magister, let's take the purchase order to the store owner!

say:1:1122548001:1.text: Oh! Is that the purchase order? Let me take a look.
say:1:1122548001:1.source_cn: 哦！这是那位商人的进货单吗？让我仔细看看。

say:2:1122548002:1.text: Yes, this price is fine! It seems like this merchant doesn't like to haggle. I think we can work together for a long time.
say:2:1122548002:1.source_cn: ……嗯，还真达到了我要的价格！看来这位商人的砍价技巧不...

say:3:1122548003:1.text: By the way, thanks a lot! If I'm being honest, you're wasted as a bounty hunter. Here's your reward!
say:3:1122548003:1.source_cn: 多谢了！不愧是赏金猎人，什么委托都办得到！
say:3:1122548003:1.male: By the way, thanks a lot! If I'm being honest, you're wasted as a bounty hunter. Here's your reward!
say:3:1122548003:1.female: By the way, thanks a lot! If I'm being honest, you're wasted as a bounty hunter. Here's your reward!
